comments.value:
A second status? 

I was about to say you should make the post sufficiently detailed that a blind programmer would be able to implement what you're looking for, but then remembered that no, a picture or mspaint drawing would be a better way to get the idea across.

Are you thinking of a special status message that shows to anyone you've muted temporarily?

I wonder if there is anything that can be written in a bio that gets the point across, then when you're in publics with people who are unfamiliar your status could be like "Neurodivergent, see bio"

Or maybe have a "currently over stimulated" group that can be used to represent at relevant times. By that I mean the group system let's you put a banner over username. Personally I have those turned off, too distracting, but I might be an outlier.

@{62df7cd83e007e467295c4e1|full_name}:  I had to Create the post and re-edit it, to fully flesh it out... - Does it make better sense now? xD

- I like to Leave my Bio unchanged, and solely use my status to tell people what I'm doing at the time when they want to join on me/ know what I'm up to and decide if they're interested ect....

I find it difficult wrapping my head around using one's "Status" to tell/ order people do something like reading a Bio- not only that, but I use my bio to write a unique story/ introduction as I'm a writer at heart xD

and don't want to clutter it with my Idiosyncrasies (as it's kind of a small text field...)

I would like a second status field so that I could have one that told people what I'm doing when they want to join on me. and then one that's seen in the game, above my head

@{62df7cd83e007e467295c4e1|full_name}: Ooo! I've actually had a think, and You've made a Great Suggestion!

- The Temporary thing

Why not have "Temporary Moderations"

 - That Reset/ Revert to normal when You leave/ Join a new world ect!

That way People can manage their Social Stimulation/ Input, and yet still have opportunity for cordial/ friendly relations in the future!

- I'ma make a Video about this!the

details:
So I just learned! That People take offense to those like me (with Aspergers Syndrome.) Or other Neurodivergents, who use the "Mute" feature, to manage the stimulation we receive in VRChat. 

It breeds unnecessary Segregation.

      - Some personalities take this action as Offensive and will resort to Blocking anybody who Mutes them...

                                                      Isolating Neurodivergents, Unnecessarily.

Recently, this has resulted in people I considered to be Cordial or friendly with, even those who I have friended 

     - Blocking me.

When I've simply used the tools available to me, to manage the social stimulation I receive. 

                        (To avoid being overstimulated. I mute People to prevent social burnout.)

I have Times where I:

- I like to have a conversation, with a select few people, But is open to anyone listening and joining in if they like. (Friend, or nonfriend, Even when I'm in a public world.) 

- I don't want to be nosy in a public world, and unintentionally hear a sensitive conversation going on. That I feel shouldn't have been accidentally overheard.

- I want to quieten a public world down because nobody's talking to me, and would prefer not to be bothered by anyone who's actively there at the time. (As I'm just going off in my own 'mental world' and doing my own thing.)

- I Don't want to Socialize.

- I Want to use the Ear Muffs feature, to quieten the whole world down. When I'm more engaged, like at a party.

- I Don't want to use the Ear Muffs feature.

- I want to use the Safety Mode, to immediately quell things down when a world I've just joined is too stimulating, or Dropping Frames for my PC.

- I Don't want to use the Safety Mode feature.

- I want to have all people muted. but keep the option where if anyone joins off me, (Let's say a Friend joins the instance.) and they've come to talk to me specifically. ~ I want to be able to immediately talk to them.

- I want to be able to mute people and have them know I've muted them. So that they have a reason why I might be ignoring them when they try to talk to me. (and I fail to respond.) 

If someone wants to talk to me in the future. I still want to be able to Unmute them when they get my attention, or if I want to engage in Socializing again...

From my understanding: 

   - A Bio, is writing used as a self-introduction. It tells the reader about who you are and gives you things to talk about when you first meet (It's Like an Ice Breaker.)

   - A Status, is for letting other people know how you feel at the time. What you are doing. Or maybe even a romantic status? (Taken/ Not Taken etc)`

   - An Activity Status, filters the level of external social engagement you want to have. (whether you want people to join you or not etc - this is the Blue, Green, Orange, and Red statuses already in VRChat.)

While some people do Read Bio's - There are also those who'll only Read someone's Status... 

(They find Reading Difficult Ect, and will only read the Name Plates above a User's Head. Or a Quick Blurb.)

This can cause a disconnect, between those of us who are More-Literate than others, and those of us who are Less-Literate. (Writers/ readers, and those who are Talkers/ Doers etc.)

While all individuals are Unique, our differences in personality can cause Discourse unintentionally.

I want to propose Two Solutions.  

The First Solution:

     - Seen as the word "Status" isn't defined as an 'Instruction/ Direction' for people to follow, like: "Read Bio" would be...

Add an "Info Status." ~ A Second Status field, that allows a User to add a quick Direction to others, for their Idiosyncrasies. This Second Status Feild would only be visible if You're in the same World as the other player.

                          "If Muted You - Read Bio"   "Won't Friend - Read Bio"   "NeuroDivergent - Read Bio"         Ect.

The "Info Status" Can be seen in the same places as your Normal Status. 

 - It's just seen Below the normal status we're all used to on Name Plates.

 - and Seen Just Below the status in the Quick Menu when you click on someone.

 

Since A Bio can sometimes be used for Expressing one's Personality...

Add an "IceBreaker" - that allows us to List 2-3 things/Habits we tend to make while Socialising, that we want people to see Immediately! (Separate from our Bio) ~ Like the "Info Status" the "Ice Breaker" would only be visible while in the same world as the other player.

"Has Aspergers Syndrome So can Mute people when overstimulated. - They mean nothing by it! and will Unmute you when asked." 

     (For Example.)

The "Ice Breaker" Can be seen when you Open up the Quick Menu, Just Below Both Statuses. 

 - This is also Seen Above your Bio when people open up your Social Page in the Main Menu. (to View Your Bio)

 - The Ice Breaker could take the place of the Self Note Section on the website, as People don't see any 'note' we put on ourselves xD

The Second Proposed Solution:

     Add A Social Cuishion Mode.

Normal Moderation has the Mute, and Block Function as they do now. With Muting Showing up as White.

Whereas Social Cuishion Mode, Moderation. Indicates when a person has Blocked your Avatar, or Muted you.

But Shows as Yellow icons instead of White. (and doesn't affect Trust Rank/Reputation.)

 

This allows You to Mute Others in a way that informs a person You've muted them, but You're not doing it with malicious intent - and You May intend on developing Cordial/ Friendly relations with them later.
title: We NEED some more Social Boxes to write in, like a Secondary, or 3rd Status.
